create_report_worker_process: create a ReportWorkerProcess to generate reports on system performance, learning progress, and agent training progress
run_report_worker: run the ReportWorkerProcess main loop that initializes distributed communication and starts processing report tasks from the queue
log_metrics_tensorboard: log metrics to TensorBoard including reward, FPS, learner metrics, and preemption decider reports at each update step
start_collection_report_worker: start the report worker collection process by sending a start_collection task with the current performance counter timestamp
get_window_episode_stats: get the windowed episode statistics dictionary containing running means for reward and other episode-level metrics
